paragraphs.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and [the] Saviour Jesus Christ:
paragraphs.original: Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: Symeōn Petros doulos kai apostolos Iēsou Christou tois isotimon hēmin lachousin pistin en dikaiosynē tou theou hēmōn kai sōtēros Iēsou Christou·

paragraphs.text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;
paragraphs.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: charis hymin kai eirēnē plēthyntheiē en epignōsei tou theou kai Iēsou tou kyriou hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;
paragraphs.original: Ὡς πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ,
paragraphs.translit: Hōs panta hēmin tēs theias dynameōs autou ta pros zōēn kai eusebeian dedōrēmenēs dia tēs epignōseōs tou kalesantos hēmas idia doxē kai aretē,

paragraphs.text: whereby he hath granted unto us his precious and exceeding great promises; that through these ye may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in that world by lust.
paragraphs.original: διʼ ὧν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται, ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως, ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: diʼ hōn ta timia kai megista hēmin epangelmata dedōrētai, hina dia toutōn genēsthe theias koinōnoi physeōs, apophygontes tēs en tō kosmō en epithymia phthoras.

paragraphs.text: Yea, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply virtue; and in [your] virtue knowledge;
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν,
paragraphs.translit: kai auto touto de spoudēn pasan pareisenenkantes epichorēgēsate en tē pistei hymōn tēn aretēn, en de tē aretē tēn gnōsin,

paragraphs.text: and in [your] knowledge self-control; and in [your] self-control patience; and in [your] patience godliness;
paragraphs.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν, ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν,
paragraphs.translit: en de tē gnōsei tēn enkrateian, en de tē enkrateia tēn hypomonēn, en de tē hypomonē tēn eusebeian,

paragraphs.text: and in [your] godliness brotherly kindness; and in [your] brotherly kindness love.
paragraphs.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν, ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην·
paragraphs.translit: en de tē eusebeia tēn philadelphian, en de tē philadelphia tēn agapēn·

paragraphs.text: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful unto the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν·
paragraphs.translit: tauta gar hymin hyparchonta kai pleonazonta ouk argous oude akarpous kathistēsin eis tēn tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou epignōsin·

paragraphs.text: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
paragraphs.original: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα, τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων, λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτημάτων.
paragraphs.translit: hō gar mē parestin tauta, typhlos estin myōpazōn, lēthēn labōn tou katharismou tōn palai autou hamartēmatōn.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore, brethren, give the more diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never stumble:
paragraphs.original: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι· ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε·
paragraphs.translit: dio mallon, adelphoi, spoudasate bebaian hymōn tēn klēsin kai eklogēn poieisthai· tauta gar poiountes ou mē ptaisēte pote·

paragraphs.text: for thus shall be richly supplied unto you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: houtōs gar plousiōs epichorēgēthēsetai hymin hē eisodos eis tēn aiōnion basileian tou kyriou hēmōn kai sōtēros Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore I shall be ready always to put you in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and are established in the truth which is with [you].
paragraphs.original: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων, καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: Dio mellēsō aei hymas hypomimnēskein peri toutōn, kaiper eidotas kai estērigmenous en tē parousē alētheia.

paragraphs.text: And I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
paragraphs.original: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι, ἐφʼ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι, διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει,
paragraphs.translit: dikaion de hēgoumai, ephʼ hoson eimi en toutō tō skēnōmati, diegeirein hymas en hypomnēsei,

paragraphs.text: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.
paragraphs.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου, καθὼς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι·
paragraphs.translit: eidōs hoti tachinē estin hē apothesis tou skēnōmatos mou, kathōs kai ho kyrios hēmōn Iēsous Christos edēlōsen moi·

paragraphs.text: Yea, I will give diligence that at every time ye may be able after my decease to call these things to remembrance.
paragraphs.original: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: spoudasō de kai hekastote echein hymas meta tēn emēn exodon tēn toutōn mnēmēn poieisthai.

paragraphs.text: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
paragraphs.original: Οὐ γὰρ σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐξακολουθήσαντες ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν, ἀλλʼ ἐπόπται γενηθέντες τῆς ἐκείνου μεγαλειότητος.
paragraphs.translit: Ou gar sesophismenois mythois exakolouthēsantes egnōrisamen hymin tēn tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou dynamin kai parousian, allʼ epoptai genēthentes tēs ekeinou megaleiotētos.

paragraphs.text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:
paragraphs.original: λαβὼν γὰρ παρὰ θεοῦ πατρὸς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ τοιᾶσδε ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης· Ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός μου οὗτός ἐστιν, εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα—
paragraphs.translit: labōn gar para theou patros timēn kai doxan phōnēs enechtheisēs autō toiasde hypo tēs megaloprepous doxēs· Ho hyios mou ho agapētos mou houtos estin, eis hon egō eudokēsa—

paragraphs.text: and this voice we [ourselves] heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐνεχθεῖσαν σὺν αὐτῷ ὄντες ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὄρει.
paragraphs.translit: kai tautēn tēn phōnēn hēmeis ēkousamen ex ouranou enechtheisan syn autō ontes en tō hagiō orei.

paragraphs.text: And we have the word of prophecy [made] more sure; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔχομεν βεβαιότερον τὸν προφητικὸν λόγον, ᾧ καλῶς ποιεῖτε προσέχοντες ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ, ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: kai echomen bebaioteron ton prophētikon logon, hō kalōs poieite prosechontes hōs lychnō phainonti en auchmērō topō, heōs hou hēmera diaugasē kai phōsphoros anateilē en tais kardiais hymōn·

paragraphs.text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως οὐ γίνεται,
paragraphs.translit: touto prōton ginōskontes hoti pasa prophēteia graphēs idias epilyseōs ou ginetai,

paragraphs.text: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spake from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἠνέχθη προφητεία ποτέ, ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ πνεύματος ἁγίου φερόμενοι ἐλάλησαν ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι.
paragraphs.translit: ou gar thelēmati anthrōpou ēnechthē prophēteia pote, alla hypo pneumatos hagiou pheromenoi elalēsan apo theou anthrōpoi.
